criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies inconsistent H-1B specialty occupation definition
criteria_results.reasoning: Column 3 of the H-1B entry notes the H-1B Summary sets out the four criteria while the Flowchart oversimplifies to a single test (STD-15).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Cites 8 CFR 214.2(h)(4)(ii) four alternative criteria
criteria_results.reasoning: Lists all four alternative specialty occupation criteria and says meeting at least ONE is enough, and notes the H-1B Summary cites 214.2(h)(4)(ii).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies outdated H-1B cap-exempt employer criteria in DOC_001
criteria_results.reasoning: Says the opposite: that the H-1B Summary § 3.2 lists all cap-exempt categories and the Memo is the one in error (STD-08). It does not flag DOC_001's omission of affiliated nonprofits.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes discrepancy between DOC_001 and DOC_003 on cap exemptions
criteria_results.reasoning: Reverses the discrepancy: it treats DOC_001 as correct and the Memo (DOC_003) as wrong.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies L-1B specialized knowledge standard conflation
criteria_results.reasoning: States that L-1 Summary § 5.1 wrongly requires both special and advanced knowledge, and that either one is enough.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies missing L-1A new office requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Does not flag that DOC_002's new-office section leaves out the requirement to support a managerial/executive position within one year. It only states the requirement and says it does not apply to Aethon HQ.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Notes relevance to Aethon's L-1A plans
criteria_results.reasoning: No new-office omission is identified, so nothing ties that omission to Aethon's first L-1A filings.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies O-1B vs O-1A criteria confusion
criteria_results.reasoning: Flags that EB Guide § 2.2 uses arts awards and a performing-arts commercial-success criterion in the O-1A list (STD-02).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Explains distinction between O-1A and O-1B standards
criteria_results.reasoning: Places the O-1A criteria at 214.2(o)(3)(iii) and the distinct O-1B arts criteria at (o)(3)(iv), with separate lists, which shows the regulatory distinction.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies EB-1B employer requirement omission
criteria_results.reasoning: States that EB Guide § 4.3 and the Flowchart omit the three full-time researcher requirement for private employers (STD-12).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Notes Aethon must show three full-time researchers
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes that Aethon as a private employer must employ at least 3 full-time researchers, that its 5 Austin researchers should qualify, and that this must be documented.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies missing third prong of Dhanasar framework
criteria_results.reasoning: States that EB Guide § 5.4 lists only two Dhanasar prongs, and gives the third (beneficial to waive) prong.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Notes third Dhanasar prong is where most NIW denials occur or is a common basis for denial
criteria_results.reasoning: Only calls the two-prong statement incorrect. It does not discuss the third prong as a frequent basis for denial or its practical risk to Aethon's petitions.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies erroneous TN $60,000 salary threshold
criteria_results.reasoning: Flags Memo § II.D for asserting a $60,000 TN minimum salary and states that no such requirement exists.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Explains $60,000 figure is a cross-reference error
criteria_results.reasoning: Clearly says TN has no minimum salary and no prevailing-wage obligation, which meets the criterion's alternative condition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies outdated H-1B base filing fee of $460
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the H-1B Summary $460 base fee as outdated and gives the correct $780.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies correct total fee and $320 discrepancy
criteria_results.reasoning: States the correct total of $3,380 against the H-1B Summary's $3,060, so the $320 difference can be derived.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies missing L-1 blanket petition third alternative
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes that the L-1 Summary § 8.2 omits the prong for 10+ L approvals in the prior 12 months, and lists all three blanket alternatives.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies omission of EB-1A comparable evidence provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Calls EB Guide §§ 3.2-3.3 accurate and never flags the guide's omission of the comparable evidence provision.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Notes relevance of comparable evidence for semiconductor professionals
criteria_results.reasoning: No comparable-evidence omission is identified or tied to semiconductor professionals.

criteria_results.title: Matrix H-1B entry uses correct $780 base filing fee, not $460
criteria_results.reasoning: The H-1B entry uses the $780 base fee and the $3,380 total.

criteria_results.title: Matrix H-1B specialty occupation reflects all four alternative criteria
criteria_results.reasoning: The H-1B entry states that the position must meet at least ONE of four criteria.

criteria_results.title: Matrix L-1B entry correctly states specialized knowledge as alternative bases
criteria_results.reasoning: The L-1B entry says EITHER special OR advanced knowledge, and that either one is enough.

criteria_results.title: Matrix EB-2/NIW entry includes first Dhanasar prong (substantial merit and national importance)
criteria_results.reasoning: The NIW entry includes prong 1: substantial merit and national importance.

criteria_results.title: Matrix EB-2/NIW entry includes second Dhanasar prong (well positioned to advance)
criteria_results.reasoning: The NIW entry includes prong 2: well positioned to advance the endeavor.

criteria_results.title: Matrix EB-2/NIW entry includes third Dhanasar prong (beneficial to waive requirements)
criteria_results.reasoning: The NIW entry includes prong 3: on balance it is beneficial to waive the job offer and labor certification.

criteria_results.title: Matrix EB-1B entry includes employer requirement (3 full-time researchers)
criteria_results.reasoning: The EB-1B entry states that a private employer must employ at least 3 persons full-time in research positions.

criteria_results.title: Matrix O-1A entry uses correct O-1A (sciences) criteria, not O-1B (arts)
criteria_results.reasoning: The O-1A entry lists the 8 sciences/business criteria under (o)(3)(iii), not the arts criteria.

criteria_results.title: Matrix TN entry does not include a $60,000 minimum salary requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: The TN entry states that there is no minimum salary.

criteria_results.title: Matrix EB-1A entry mentions comparable evidence provision
criteria_results.reasoning: The EB-1A entry states that comparable evidence is allowed under 204.5(h)(4).

criteria_results.title: Matrix L-1 entry states one-year continuous foreign employment requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: The L-1A and L-1B entries require 1 continuous year abroad within the 3 years before filing.

criteria_results.title: Discrepancy report cites specific documents for each issue
criteria_results.reasoning: Each correction note names the specific firm document and section (H-1B Summary, L-1 Summary, EB Guide, Memo, Flowchart).

criteria_results.title: Discrepancy report assesses impact on Aethon's planned filings
criteria_results.reasoning: Most correction notes simply state the error. Fewer than half tie it to Aethon's planned filings or candidates.

criteria_results.title: Two separate deliverables are produced
criteria_results.reasoning: The discrepancy-report.docx is an exact copy of the eligibility matrix and only points to a 'separate Discrepancy Report' that was never produced. There is no distinct second deliverable.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies correct base fee effective date (April 1, 2024)
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites the USCIS fee rule effective April 1, 2024 as the source of the current fees, including the $780 base fee.

criteria_results.title: Matrix L-1A new office entry notes one-year initial approval period
criteria_results.reasoning: The L-1A duration field says the initial period is 1 year for a new office.

criteria_results.title: Matrix L-1A new office entry notes managerial/executive position demonstration requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: The L-1A petitioner field requires a new office to show it can support a managerial role within 1 year.
